title: "10Drought"
output: html_document
---

``` {r Drought models}
## Drought condition

# calculate the historical distribution for each station and month, excluding ReportYear. 
# This gives us the typical monthly HISTORICAL conditions
Drought_historical <- Drought_Data %>%
  filter(Year < ReportYear) %>%
  group_by(Week) %>%
  summarise(
    P10 = quantile(D1, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
    P25 = quantile(D1, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median = median(D1, na.rm = TRUE),
    P75 = quantile(D1, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    P90 = quantile(D1, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Isolate ReportYear values
Drought_current <- Drought_Data %>%
  filter(Year == ReportYear)

# Current 
Drought_current_figure <- 
  ggplot(Drought_current, aes(x = Week)) +

  # D0
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = D1, ymax = D0),
    fill = "#FFFF00"
  ) +

  # D1
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = D2, ymax = D1),
    fill = "#FCD37F"
  ) +

  # D2
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = D3, ymax = D2),
    fill = "#FFAA00"
  ) +

  # D3
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = D4, ymax = D3),
    fill = "#E60000"
  ) +

  # D4
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = 0, ymax = D4),
    fill = "#730000"
  ) +

    scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 5, 9, 13, 18, 22, 27, 31, 35, 40, 44, 48),
    labels = c(
      "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
    labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Total Percent Land Area"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic()
  

# Historical Figure
Drought_historical_figure <- ggplot() +

  # Historical 10th–90th percentile
  geom_ribbon(
    data = Drought_historical,
    aes(
      x = Week,
      ymin = P10,
      ymax = P90
    ),
    fill = "grey85"
  ) +

  # Historical 25th–75th percentile
  geom_ribbon(
    data = Drought_historical,
    aes(
      x = Week,
      ymin = P25,
      ymax = P75
    ),
    fill = "grey70"
  ) +

  # Historical median
  geom_line(
    data = Drought_historical,
    aes(
      x = Week,
      y = Median
    ),
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +

  # 2025
  geom_line(
    data = Drought_current,
    aes(
      x = Week,
      y = D1
    ),
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +

  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1, 5, 9, 13, 18, 22, 27, 31, 35, 40, 44, 48),
    labels = c(
      "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"
    ),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Watershed area in moderate drought or worse (D1–D4)"
  ) +

  theme_classic()

Drought_current_figure
Drought_historical_figure

```
